visual_review.notes: Autonomous review of every chronological source frame, enlarged identity/grip/alpha transitions on dark and light backgrounds, and every selected phase in the native Godot 128px reference-height overview. Attack joins clean v1 anticipation/extension with v2 guided contact/recovery; v1 collision-spark intervals and v2 ready-to-thrust snap excluded. Joins v1 27-to33 and v1 40-to-v2 60 checked at native size with consistent anatomy/shaft/grips. Preserve eight original idle poses,240ms timing, map strip and catalog. Deliberate combat retiming shortens long holds; no duplicate/reversed/interpolated padding.
